proposals.issue_title: Brittle Image API Fallback & Rate Limiting on Shared GitHub Actions IPs
proposals.current_pain_description: Shared GitHub Actions runner IPs trigger frequent rate limits (HTTP 429) and blocks (HTTP 403 on AI Horde, 429 on Gemini). Currently, pipelines fail silently or crash, losing execution time and wasting Hugo's 10 hours/week on manual restarts.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized Python utility module `libs/image_generator.py` with a strict circuit-breaker pattern. It must try APIs in order of cost/quality: 1) Together AI (FLUX-schnell), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI, 3) Runware (PAYG fallback, capped at 0.006$ per image), 4) Pollinations (last resort). Implement exponential backoff with jitter specifically designed for shared CI runner environments.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of silent pipeline crashes; ensures reliable daily image generation without manual intervention.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Trademark Filter Leading to Account Suspension Risks
proposals.current_pain_description: Automated trend scrapers and LLM prompt generators can easily output copyrighted or trademarked phrases (e.g., Disney quotes, brand names, trademarked slogans). Publishing these on Redbubble/KDP will lead to instant, irreversible account bans.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a pre-generation prompt sanitizer script. It should run the generated titles and prompts against a lightweight, offline JSON list of high-risk POD trademarks (e.g., 'Velcro', 'Super Bowl', 'Harry Potter') and use a regex-based blocklist before sending requests to the image generators or metadata compilers.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Protects newly registered Redbubble and Amazon KDP accounts from lifetime bans during the bootstrapping phase.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Metadata & File Management Bottleneck on Mobile (Termux)
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has a mobile phone. Downloading raw images from GitHub Actions run artifacts, organizing them, and manually entering titles, descriptions, and tags on Redbubble/KDP is extremely tedious and error-prone on a small screen.
proposals.proposed_fix: Modify pipelines to auto-generate a standardized upload package for each run. This includes: 1) A formatted `.csv` file matching Redbubble's bulk upload format exactly. 2) A `.zip` containing optimized, correctly named, and upscaled assets. 3) Auto-committing these packages to a private 'distribution' branch or releasing them as GitHub Release Assets so Hugo can download them with 1 click.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual listing time on mobile from 15 minutes per design to under 2 minutes.

proposals.issue_title: Gray/Low-Contrast Vector Outputs in Coloring Book Pipeline
proposals.current_pain_description: FLUX-schnell and Pollinations often output grayscale shading, sketchy lines, or dark gray backgrounds instead of clean black-and-white line art. This makes coloring books look cheap and unprofessional.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight Python post-processing step using `Pillow` and `opencv-python-headless` in the GitHub Actions workflow. The script must: 1) Convert images to grayscale. 2) Apply adaptive thresholding (Gaussian) to force pixels to absolute black (#000000) or absolute white (#FFFFFF). 3) Run a bilateral filter to smooth out jagged lines before exporting.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures 100% sellable, high-contrast, professional-looking coloring book pages without manual editing.

proposals.issue_title: High GitHub Actions Cache Misses and Slow Run Times
proposals.current_pain_description: Every pipeline run currently reinstalls heavy dependencies (like `opencv-python-headless`, `Pillow`, and various API SDKs) from scratch. This wastes valuable GitHub Actions free tier minutes (2000 min/month) and makes runs take 5-10 minutes instead of 1-2 minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement strict dependency caching in all `.github/workflows/*.yml` files using `actions/cache@v3` keyed on `requirements.txt` or `pyproject.toml`. Group common dependencies into a single base requirements file to maximize cache hits.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Cuts pipeline execution time by up to 70%, preserving free tier minutes and accelerating the iteration loop.

proposals.issue_title: Missing Cross-Pollination of Assets (Single Asset, Multi-Platform)
proposals.current_pain_description: Assets are generated in silos. A high-quality graphic made for a coloring book or a sticker is never reused for other high-margin formats like tumbler wraps, SVG packs, or KDP low-content covers, missing out on free multi-platform exposure.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a 'Global Asset Router' workflow. When an asset is marked as 'approved' or 'high_quality' by the `agent_gemini_quality_check`, it automatically triggers sub-workflows to resize, adjust aspect ratios, and package that same graphic into: 1) A PNG sticker (Redbubble), 2) A seamless pattern (Tumbler Wraps), 3) A vector SVG (Etsy/Cults3D).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory volume across platforms by 3x with zero extra design generation cost.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures of Workflows on Mobile Monitoring
proposals.current_pain_description: If a GitHub Actions workflow fails due to API errors or run limits, Hugo only finds out if he manually opens GitHub on his phone or checks his emails. There is no real-time push notification, leading to wasted days where nothing ran.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a lightweight, conditional step at the end of every workflow using a `if: failure()` block. This step will send a simplified, actionable failure payload (Workflow name, error snippet, run link) to a free Telegram channel or Discord webhook directly readable on Hugo's phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Provides instant, real-time debugging awareness on mobile, reducing system downtime to minutes.
